snippet.title: Pao Lee Ming Kanshuu: Fuusui Nyuumon (Intro + Start Menu) [PS1]
snippet.description:
Pao Lee Ming Kanshuu: Fuusui Nyuumon (Supervisor Pao Lee Ming: Introduction to Feng Shui) [鮑黎明監修: 風水入門] is a PS1 tutorial manual on the basics and step by step instructions on how to diagnose objects and living spaces and their weaknesses through the art of Feng Shui. I only decided to record the intro and start screen because I have absolutely no idea on how to use this or navigate this.　

Pao Lee Ming appears to have passed away back in 2010 unfortunately :(

EDIT: Updated link. The old link had been closed by whichever domain hosting service owned the website on the 5th of May of this year.
https://web.archive.org/web/20160618132144/http://www.biglobe.venusfortune.com/pao-seimei/info/profile.html
